neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * The [Claude Tag API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/claude-tag-api) is available in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations with the `experimental-claude-tag-2026-10-21` beta header. Its `/v1/organizations/claude_tag/` endpoints read and change [Claude Tag](https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/overview) settings on Slack channels and Slack workspaces, show which settings apply in a channel and where each comes from, and attach Access bundles. Call it with an Admin API key that your primary owner creates in claude.ai with the `read:claude_tag` or `write:claude_tag` scope. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations.
